records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We generated 35% and 36% of our total revenues through Arrow for the nine months ended December 31, 2024 and 2023, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Subscription revenue generated through indirect distribution channels accounted for approximately 90% of total subscription revenue in both the nine months ended December 31, 2024 and 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: –Net cash provided by operating activities was impacted by net income adjusted for the impact of non-cash charges and an increase in deferred revenue, partially offset by an increase in accounts receivable.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: To the extent the U.S. dollar weakens against foreign currencies, the translation of these foreign currency denominated transactions generally results in increased revenues, operating expenses and income from operations for our non-U.S. operations.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: –Net cash used in investing activities was related to $65.9 million for the acquisitions of Appranix and Clumio, $3.0 million of capital expenditures and $0.8 million for the purchase of equity securities.
